description: Small draggable desktop HUD with four on/off toggles (indicator per state): global Soft Body Physics, GiveMeFPS (GT) plugin enable, and GiveMeFPS Advanced Colliders, and High Quality Physics (mirrors the real VaM setting). Drag the panel anywhere on screen; position and states persist with the scene. Self-contained, no dependencies. v5 adds the High Physics toggle. v4 adds a VR mode: in VR the HUD is a free-floating world-space panel you drag with the laser (header or body), with BRING and PIN buttons, Attach To Left/Right Hand, Always On Top, and a Remember VR Layout setting (scale + placement saved to Saves/PluginData/zerot/ToggleHUD/vr_layout.json). Desktop behaviour is unchanged.
instructions: Add ToggleHUD.cslist to any Atom (a Person or an Empty) as a Session or Scene plugin. A panel appears in the top-left; drag it by the header or body. Click a row to toggle it (Soft Body, GiveMeFPS, Adv Colliders, High Physics). Use the plugin UI sliders for scale, a Show HUD toggle, and Reset HUD Position. v4 adds a VR mode: in VR the HUD is a free-floating world-space panel you drag with the laser (header or body), with BRING and PIN buttons, Attach To Left/Right Hand, Always On Top, and a Remember VR Layout setting (scale + placement saved to Saves/PluginData/zerot/ToggleHUD/vr_layout.json). Desktop behaviour is unchanged.
